builds.name: Reference: Ranked support core
builds.goal: Reference for Pyke: the core and runes ranked Emerald+ support players use most (4,266 ranked Emerald+ games with this core on OP.GG, patch 16.20, 52% win rate).
builds.hypothesis: A roaming pick-and-execute assassin who hooks targets, crosses them with a returning stun and resets his ultimate on eligible deaths. The current support provider core anchors this plan; later slots are observed options or reviewed kit completions. Core in purchase order: Umbral Glaive → Youmuu's Ghostblade → Edge of Night. Hail of Blades keystone as played in those games. Remaining slots: Boots of Swiftness, Bloodsong, Guardian Angel.
builds.summary: The proven support baseline: Umbral Glaive → Youmuu's Ghostblade → Edge of Night, with Hail of Blades.
testPlan: Play it in support as your control build. Follow the purchase order; the core (Umbral Glaive → Youmuu's Ghostblade → Edge of Night) is what ranked players complete first.
Record kills, deaths, damage dealt and the minute you finish each core item, then compare other builds against these numbers in similar games.
Adapt the last two items to the enemy team: armor or magic resist against fed carries, anti-heal against healing, penetration once enemies stack resists.
failureConditions: Your results with this build fall clearly below the 52% ranked baseline over several games in the same role.
The enemy team composition makes the core items poor answers; swap the flexible slots before abandoning the core.
tradeoffs: Proven and predictable, so opponents know what to expect. It is a starting point, not the best build for every matchup.
The observed core and individual options do not establish six-item build statistics. Late slots are kit-based inferences.
Six-slot completion is our kit-based inference, not an observed six-item win-rate build.  Situational options replace an appropriate slot; they are not added as a seventh item.
buyOrder: Core in purchase order: Umbral Glaive → Youmuu's Ghostblade → Edge of Night.
Boots after the first item unless the lane needs them earlier.
coverageNotes: Source: OP.GG ranked Emerald+ solo/duo, patch 16.20, checked 2026-10-14. Core items and rune page are observed; later slots are observed options or reviewed completions. Win rates describe those games, not a prediction for yours.
builds.author: Rift Build Lab ranked data

kitEvidence.formula:
Tap: Pyke stabs, dealing [100 / 150 / 200 / 250 / 300 + (0.75) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage to the first enemy hit, preferring champions. They are then Slowed by [90]% for [1] second.

Hold: Pyke throws his harpoon, dealing [100 / 150 / 200 / 250 / 300 + (0.75) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage to the first enemy hit and Pulling them towards him. They are then Slowed by [90]% for [1] second.

If Pyke successfully hits an enemy champion or the channel does not complete successfully, [75]% of the Mana cost is refunded.

Pyke stores [0.09 + (0.002) × Stat(29)] of damage taken from champions, increased to [0.4 + (0.004) × Stat(29)] when there's more than one enemy nearby. Pyke can store up to [80 + (8) × AD[statFormula=2]] damage. While unseen by enemies, he rapidly regenerates this stored damage.

Additionally, Pyke converts all Maximum Health increases to Attack Damage instead at a rate of 14 Health to 1 Attack Damage.

Pyke strikes all enemy champions in an X, teleporting to and executing targets below [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=250, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 7, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 40.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 10, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 30.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 12, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 20.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 17, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 10.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}]) + (0.8) × AD[statFormula=2] + (1.5) × Stat(29)] Health. Champions above the threshold and non-champions instead take physical damage equal to [50]% of that amount ([(characterLevelBreakpoints(start=250, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 7, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 40.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 10, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 30.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 12, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 20.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 17, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 10.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}]) + (0.8) × AD[statFormula=2] + (1.5) × Stat(29)) × (0.5)]). 

When an enemy champion dies inside the X, Pyke can Recast this Ability for free within [20] seconds. If he executed that champion, the last assisting ally will also get kill gold. If he did not, he will still get kill gold as if he did.

Pyke dashes, leaving a drowned phantom behind him that returns to him shortly. The phantom Stuns for [1.25 + (0.01) × Stat(29)] seconds and deals [100 / 150 / 200 / 250 / 300 + (1) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage to champions.
Pyke gains Camouflage and [45 + (2) × Stat(29)]% Move Speed decaying over [5] seconds.

builds.name: Unseen recovery strike
builds.summary: Use the required unseen recovery interval to ready an Umbral attack on re-entry.
builds.goal: Use the required unseen recovery interval to ready an Umbral attack on re-entry.
builds.hypothesis: Passive regenerates stored champion damage while unseen; W grants camouflage and lethality-scaled decaying speed. Umbral now adds a true-damage attack after being unseen, while Edge of Night protects re-entry. Q pull and E return stun can secure one attack before leaving again.
testPlan: Required state: Take finite champion damage, leave vision, recover, then land one readied attack.
Record unseen duration, gray-health recovery and the first attack packet on return.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Persistent vision prevents recovery/readiness and turns the attack plan into a fragile dive.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Camouflage does not guarantee being unseen near revealing enemies.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Celestial Opposition, Umbral Glaive, Edge of Night, Eclipse, Youmuu's Ghostblade, Ionian Boots of Lucidity. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

builds.name: Situational adaptation: Engage and rescue
builds.goal: Situational adaptation for Pyke: adapt to the specified fight rather than assume one universal build
builds.hypothesis: A roaming pick-and-execute assassin who hooks targets, crosses them with a returning stun and resets his ultimate on eligible deaths. The kit's bonus-health conversion means tank packages are an intentional weak/high-risk comparison, not ordinary extra HP. Keep R execute threshold and cash earned from kills finite. A support quest and protective actives test allied survival after an engage.
builds.summary: A support quest and protective actives test allied survival after an engage.
testPlan: Kit question for Pyke: The kit's bonus-health conversion means tank packages are an intentional weak/high-risk comparison, not ordinary extra HP. Keep R execute threshold and cash earned from kills finite.

Start with the early core (Support quest, boots and Locket; choose later actives by threat) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use real support income and keep the quest/vision slot.

Compare against the reference route at the same level, gold spent, finite stacks and opponent setup. Record unused gold; isolate an item change before changing runes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: A support quest and protective actives test allied survival after an engage. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern. Choose the opponent profile this defensive route is intended to address, then repeat against the wrong damage type.

Q evidence: Pyke either stabs an enemy in front of him or pulls an enemy towards him. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Low income rarely reaches six items; Mikael does not remove airborne/suppression.

The route fails Pyke's stated kit question: The kit's bonus-health conversion means tank packages are an intentional weak/high-risk comparison, not ordinary extra HP. Keep R execute threshold and cash earned from kills finite.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility. Also record allies lost while spending on personal damage.
tradeoffs: Low income rarely reaches six items; Mikael does not remove airborne/suppression.
Full cost 10,650 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
Counter-items are conditional. Change boots/defense for the real matchup, then record the modified setup.
buyOrder: Support quest, boots and Locket; choose later actives by threat. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Begin with the actual support quest item; Celestial Opposition is earned by transformation, not directly bought as a 400-gold legendary. Keep buying vision.
Knight's Vow, Zeke's Convergence, Mikael's Blessing are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

builds.name: Health-conversion caster
builds.summary: Test whether health-bearing AD items improve the execute threshold through passive conversion.
builds.goal: Test whether health-bearing AD items improve the execute threshold through passive conversion.
builds.hypothesis: Pyke converts maximum-health gains at fourteen health per AD. Shojin and Black Cleaver supply health plus AD; Shojin basic haste supports Q/E. R threshold explicitly includes AD[statFormula=2] and Stat(29), while E stun and W speed scale with Stat(29). Compare the conversion against lost lethality.
testPlan: Required state: Use observed post-conversion AD and lethality, not a fictitious increased health pool.
Record actual health, AD, W speed, E stun and R threshold before/after each health purchase.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Less lethality may shorten E control and weaken threshold/access despite higher AD.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Health purchases do not give Pyke ordinary tank maximum health.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
